--watch.waiver: A long-running loop whose cost per change is one rerun of the check the check rows already count, plus filesystem-notification waiting no instruction count measures.

--glob.waiver: Keeps the part of the batch show_batch_all already generates and counts that a pattern matches; the matcher walks each coordinate once, in time bounded by the pattern's length and the coordinate's, and reads nothing more.

--path.waiver: Picks the tree to resolve in; the show rows already resolve in a whole fixture tree.

--path-base.waiver: Rewrites the printed paths, after the resolution the show rows already count.

--glob.waiver: Keeps the rows of the scan the list row already counts that a pattern matches; the matcher walks each coordinate once, in time bounded by the pattern's length and the coordinate's, and reads nothing more.

--path-base.waiver: Rewrites the printed paths, after the scan the list row already counts.

--total.waiver: Prints how many rows the list rows already build and count, in place of printing them.

--from.waiver: Resolves the source as show does and keeps the edges of the scan the refs row already counts that its own body holds, one comparison each, and reads nothing more.

--glob.waiver: Keeps the edges of the scan the refs row already counts whose cited coordinate a pattern matches; the matcher walks each coordinate once, in time bounded by the pattern's length and the coordinate's, and reads nothing more.

--path-base.waiver: Rewrites the printed paths, after the scan the refs row already counts.

--glob.waiver: Keeps the citations of the scan the cover row already counts whose cited coordinate a pattern matches; the matcher walks each coordinate once, in time bounded by the pattern's length and the coordinate's, and reads nothing more.

--path-base.waiver: Rewrites the printed paths, after the scan the cover row already counts.
Rewrites the printed paths, after the planning the fmt_check row already counts.

--write.waiver: Computes the same rewrites fmt_check counts and then writes them; fmt_check runs it as its uncounted setup, and a counted row would change the fixture between runs.

fetch.waiver: Materializes one external snapshot over the network, run by hand when a fact changes; its cost is the remote fetch, which no instruction count measures.

--path-base.waiver: Rewrites the one path --explain prints, after the scan the id rows already count.

init.waiver: Run once when a repository adopts grund, and scaffolds files rather than scanning a tree.

config.waiver: Reads and validates one grund.toml, run by hand; the same config load is inside every counted row.

schema.waiver: Reads one grund.toml and prints its view, run by hand; it scans no tree, and the same config load is inside every counted row.

guide.waiver: Prints fixed text and scans nothing.

completions.waiver: Prints a fixed shell script once per shell setup and scans nothing; the ID lookup it installs runs `grund complete ids` on each Tab, which is inventoried as the hidden command `complete`.

integrations.waiver: Prints or installs editor and terminal integration snippets once per machine and scans nothing.

node.waiver: V8's JIT and garbage-collector threads move the Node addon's instruction counts between runs of one build, so a count would not hold the same-binary bound; it stays waived until its counts are shown repeatable.
